item.title: Revenue Tap
item.description: Revenue Tap puts AdMob, AdSense, Google Play, App Store Connect, and Google Analytics on one dashboard so you can see ads, store proceeds, installs, and usage without jumping between consoles.

item.title: Lawn Bowls Diary
item.description: Lawn Bowls Diary is your training and match journal for the green — built for bowlers who want clearer practice, better game notes, and progress you can see.

item.title: Speed Puzzling Diary
item.description: Speed Puzzling Diary is the training journal for competitive and recreational speed puzzlers. Plan practices, run timed drills, log rounds, and see what actually makes you faster.

item.title: Curling Diary
item.description: Curling Diary is your on-ice performance journal and practice companion — built for competitive and committed recreational curlers who want more than scattered notes.
